images.alt: A robot on the left holds pipes that pass through inspection windows in a central wall before reaching a database, servers and a chat bubble on the right; a key ring hangs on the far side of the wall.
images.prompt: A small generic robot on the left holds a bundle of pipes that run rightward. In the centre, a solid wall with a single inspection gate; each pipe passes through its own small window in the gate, where a magnifying lens looks at what flows through. A ring of keys hangs on a hook on the far side of the wall, out of the robot's reach. To the right, plain shapes for a database cylinder, a cluster of server boxes and a chat bubble receive the pipes. Everything centred with generous margin on all sides.

images.alt: Two lanes: on top a long scroll passes under a stamp unchanged; below, the same scroll goes into a machine and comes out short and full of gaps, with shreds beside it.
images.prompt: Two horizontal lanes stacked in the centre of the frame. Top lane: a long unbroken paper scroll runs left to right and passes under a single rubber stamp; the scroll continues out the right side intact. Bottom lane: the same scroll enters a boxy machine with a funnel on top, and out the right side comes a much shorter strip with visible gaps torn out of it, next to a small pile of shredded pieces. Keep both lanes well inside the margins.

images.alt: A robot practises against its own reflection in a mirror on the left; on the right the same robot faces a semicircle of five differently shaped training dummies.
images.prompt: Left half: a small generic robot practises in front of a single tall mirror, and the reflection is an identical robot making the exact same pose. Right half: the same robot faces a loose semicircle of five plain training dummies, each a different height and shape, some seated, some standing. A thin vertical divider between the halves. Everything centred with wide margins.

images.alt: Three connected boxes: a sealed document with a key, a box inside a box holding a gear, and a turnstile with a checkmark and a cross; a small robot feeds paper into the first.
images.prompt: Three plain boxes in a row across the middle of the frame, connected by arrows left to right. First box: a document with a wax seal and a small key beside it. Second box: a smaller box drawn inside a larger box, with a running gear inside the inner one. Third box: a turnstile gate with a checkmark on one side and a cross on the other. A small robot stands at the far left feeding a slip of paper into the first box. Keep the row well inside the frame edges.

images.alt: A robot slides a slip across a desk, a hand with a stamp hovers over it, and the slip drops into a slot on a small machine; a ledger strip below records tick marks.
images.prompt: A desk seen from the front, centred. On the left a small robot slides a paper slip across the desk. In the middle a hand holding a rubber stamp hovers over the slip. On the right, past the stamp, the slip drops into a slot on top of a small machine with a lever. Below the desk, a long ledger strip runs the full width with a row of small tick marks recording each slip. Generous margin around everything.
